Title: ServiceNow Change Request List: Building AND Filters
Description: Steps to open the filter panel and add sequential AND conditions for filtering Change Requests.
- Open the Change Request List page to access the filter controls.
- Click the 'Show / hide filter' button to reveal the filter input panel.
- Click the field chooser combobox for the first condition to select a filter field.
- Select the desired field (e.g., 'Type', 'Requested by') from the dropdown list.
- Click the value chooser combobox for the selected condition to set the operator and value.
- Use 'select_option' if clicking the visible value option fails, specifying the value (e.g., 'normal').
- Click the 'Add AND Condition To Condition N' button to append the next filter criteria.
- Repeat the field selection and value setting steps for each subsequent condition.

Title: ServiceNow Filter Panel: Interaction Pitfalls
Description: Key UI signals and interaction methods observed when building complex AND filters.
- The filter panel is controlled by the 'Show / hide filter' button (bid a47) which toggles the 'change_requestfilterdiv'.
- Field selection uses a combobox with placeholder text 'All of these conditions must be met. -- choose field --'.
- Value selection often requires using 'select_option' on the combobox if the visible option element is not directly clickable.
- The operator for the 'Model' field was successfully set to 'is empty string' using the operator combobox.
- Each new condition is added via a specific button labeled 'Add AND Condition To Condition N: [Previous Field] is [Previous Value]'.
- The trajectory ended after adding the condition for 'Short description' without setting its value or operator.
- Ensure the 'All of these conditions must be met' logic is maintained by clicking the correct 'Add AND' button.
- Field options like 'Type', 'Requested by', and 'Model' are available in the standard field chooser dropdown.
